name: pattern match skipping by last occurrence
mechanism: compare the pattern from its end, and on a mismatch shift the pattern forward by how far the mismatching text character is from its last occurrence in the pattern, skipping text without examining it

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Boyer–Moore string-search algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Substrings: amortized linear (sublinear in most times) algorithm for substring search
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Boyer–Moore–Horspool algorithm': Simplification of Boyer–Moore
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Zhu–Takaoka string matching algorithm': a variant of Boyer–Moore

requires: a table of last occurrences per alphabet symbol
fails_when: worst case still linear-quadratic in some variants
